text:
jonathan: Quick heads-up — finishing rollout for slice-3 in us-west-2 in ~10m. After-bake checks planned: health checks, p95 latency, error budget. @priya can you watch p95 and errors? @katie can you stand by for logs? deploy-bot will post the deploy summary when done.

priya: on it. i'll watch p95 and 5xx. will post if p95 > 300ms or 5xx spike.

sam_w: i'll kick off quick smoke now once deploy-bot confirms. basic checks: 
```
# health
curl -fsS https://api-usw2.redwood.example/health || echo "health fail"
# perf sample
python perf_probe.py --model small --qps 1
```

deploy-bot: Deployment complete: service=runtime-slice-3 version=v2.6.0 commit=ff9a4b. canary: 3/3 hosts healthy. timestamp=1767000050

priya: initial metrics: p50 80ms, p95 180ms, 5xx=0. No spike yet. continuing 10m watch.

sam_w: smoke run results: health ok, sample query returned 200 and correct output. logs show small transient kv-cache warming entries but nothing alarming.

katie: reviewing infra logs — one GPU node saw higher load during batch warmup, but no OOMs. I left a note in the watch doc.

jonathan: thanks — plan: hold autoscaler for 15m, if no regressions we'll promote config to full traffic. rollback plan in case: revert to v2.5.8 and drain slice. @deploy-bot please mark canary-ok if no alerts in 15m.

priya: copy. i'll flag if p95 > 300ms or if error rate > 0.5%.

katie: small tweak applied: reduced batch size on slice-3 from 32 -> 24 to lower tail latency. it's live; monitoring for 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary status: OK (no alerts) at 1767000200. Marking as healthy. :white_check_mark:

jonathan: excellent — leaving this thread open for any late regressions. closing at 1767000200 if no changes. :thumbsup:
